correctness.rationale: The 24-vertex, 36-edge graph and its two relevant graph powers are completely reconstructed by standard-library verification. Eight signed octahedral hexagon-face cycles have zero boundary; unique alternating-triangle coefficient cocycles prove their integral linear independence. Their 48 symmetry actions are exactly the unsigned face permutation action. Lefschetz traces on all simplices at scales two and three match determinant plus fixed-hexagon count, and determinant alone, respectively. The independently rebuilt complete mod-two boundary matrices have ranks (73,30) and (145,326); the inclusion map has rank one mod two. Previously established torsion-free sphere-wedge homotopy types, whose hypotheses match the exact graph and metric, lift this nonzero inclusion to a rank-one rational map; the eight face spheres become boundaries at scale three. Semisimplicity and the known scale-four vanishing give the claimed equivariant rational persistence intervals. All relevant finite calculations were re-executed from the actual packaged script.

originality.rationale: The closest published same-graph homotopy classification gives the ranks and a second published four-letter permutahedral result gives the mod-two inclusion rank and ordinary barcode. Both are acknowledged as prior. Neither published statement, separately or in conjunction, determines the 48-element rational representations, nor the coherent unsigned permutation action on eight geometric hexagonal sphere cycles, nor the character-valued local/global persistence splitting. No indexed equivalent statement was located; unindexed equivalents remain possible.
residual_risks: Equivalent unpublished or poorly indexed computation could exist, especially in terminology of Cayley/permutahedral graph power homology.
Finite checks establish the asserted finite calculation, not a family theorem.
The rational statement relies on the cited published torsion-free wedge results to connect mod-two map to characteristic zero.

The ordinary mod-two persistence has already been published for the identical graph under its permutahedral alias; novelty is restricted to natural rational symmetry representations and geometric equivariant basis.

value.rationale: This refines an already known nonequivariant and mod-two barcode by exhibiting a canonical geometric kernel: eight oriented hexagon-face sphere cycles with unsigned octahedral permutation action die at scale three, whereas the surviving line transforms by the determinant character. These natural geometric and 48-element equivariant data are invisible in the known numerical ranks and intervals and give an interpretable representation-valued persistence invariant of a canonical Archimedean/permutahedral graph.
